how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-alterac-valley-02.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:7367:obj:0: Find the ⟦E1⟧ Explosives Expert and kill him. Return to the Stormpike Explosives Expert when the task is complete.
rows.quest:7367:details:0: The ⟦E1⟧ have their front lines and bases booby trapped, ⟦1⟧. You have to watch your step when invading enemy territory.
rows.quest:7367:details:1: BIf you want to make a solid strike against them, you must destroy their source of anti personnel munitions - I'm talking about their explosives expert. If you kill him, you are safe to disarm the mines. As long as he is kept down, the mines will also stay down.
rows.quest:7367:details:2: BYou will probably find him in a tower near the Iceblood ⟦E2⟧. Good luck!
rows.quest:7368:obj:0: Find the Stormpike Explosives Expert and kill him. Return to the ⟦E1⟧ Explosives Expert when the task is complete.
rows.quest:7368:details:0: I know all about landmines. I'm the one that lays all the mines on the front lines here, after all.
rows.quest:7368:details:1: BIf you want to defuse the Stormpike mine fields, all you have to do is kill their explosives expert. That dwarven coward is no doubt hiding in the first tower on the Field of Strife. Take him out and those landmines won't come back after they've been disarmed.
rows.quest:7368:details:2: BIf you do happen to kill him, come back here and let me know. No good deed should go unrewarded.
rows.quest:7401:obj:0: You have been tasked with slaying opposing Dwarf players in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:7401:obj:1: BKill a Dwarf and rip out their spine. Take the Dwarf Spine to Sergeant Yazra Bloodsnarl at ⟦E1⟧ Keep.
rows.quest:7401:details:0: By order of Sergeant Yazra Bloodsnarl, all dwarves on the field of battle are to be killed on sight.
rows.quest:7401:details:1: BShould you slay a dwarf in combat, rip out their spine, leaving a spineless heap of stink and rot to serve as a warning to any and all that dare oppose the might of the ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:7401:details:2: BReturn to Sergeant Yazra Bloodsnarl with proof of your heroics.
rows.quest:7401:completion:0: You now have license to decimate dwarves by the dozen, ⟦2⟧!
rows.quest:7401:completion:1: B<Yazra stares off into the distance for a moment.>
rows.quest:7401:completion:2: BYou never forget your first de-spining...
rows.quest:7402:obj:0: You have been tasked with slaying opposing Orc players in ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:7402:obj:1: BKill an Orc and take their Orc Tooth back to Corporal Noreg Stormpike at Dun Baldar.
rows.quest:7402:details:0: By order of Corporal Noreg Stormpike, all able bodied soldiers of Stormpike are required to slay any opposing orcs that they meet upon the field of battle.
rows.quest:7402:details:1: BSoldiers are required to remove a tusk or tooth from the maw of the enemy and present said tooth as proof of their accomplishment.
rows.quest:8369:obj:0: Bring 3 ⟦E3⟧ Marks of Honor to a ⟦E4⟧ Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
rows.quest:8369:details:0: Listen up, ⟦3⟧. No matter what you might have heard about the battle raging in ⟦E3⟧, one thing remains true: the Stormpike Expedition invaded ⟦E1⟧ Territory. The day we allow the ⟦E5⟧ to invade ⟦E4⟧ lands without a forceful response is the day I hang up my axe and live the rest of my life in shame. Go forth and expel the invaders!
rows.quest:8369:completion:0: You've shown great bravery in protecting our lands in ⟦E3⟧! I will tell my superiors of your deeds.
rows.quest:8375:obj:0: Bring 3 ⟦E3⟧ Marks of Honor to an ⟦E5⟧ Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.
rows.quest:8375:details:0: Make no mistake about it, ⟦4⟧. The ⟦E4⟧ is quite right when they say ⟦E3⟧ is ⟦E1⟧ Territory.
rows.quest:8375:details:1: BYou see, the Stormpike Expedition arrived as peaceful visitors to the area in search of ore and relics. The Frostwolves reacted with the most brutal and uncivilized act of aggression the ⟦E5⟧ has experienced.
rows.quest:8375:details:2: BLet us never forget the brave dwarves that perished in that cowardly unannounced attack. Go now, ⟦5⟧, do your part in the battle for ⟦E3⟧. For the ⟦E5⟧!
rows.quest:8375:completion:0: You've shown great bravery in protecting our lands in ⟦E3⟧! I will tell my superiors of your deeds.
